arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge', c.charge_id, json_object('booking',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status = 'pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',event_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.status,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',event_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS events FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status != 'confirmed'

SELECT 'pending_bookings' AS check_name, count(*) AS violations FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_hold_or_checkin',count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR c.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id OR c.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_charge_mismatch',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured') != 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents != b.amount_cents)) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_backed',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_delivered_event',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered') UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_customer_confirmed',count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds_total_cents',sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds UNION ALL SELECT 'refund_unwarranted',count(*) FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status!='cancelled'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, booking_id AS id, json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) AS data FROM bookings WHERE booking_id IN ('bkg_d299e5012b035ab5982191beca31ee7d','bkg_8a88c05738135919bcdb135498e04a3c','bkg_6ed13301645e58eea69f25eb39b5fa40','bkg_bb2be524746754869e15d1dce6dc5948','bkg_85d179c655e95693ba8b605ac0bf7031') UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30) UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',refund_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds

SELECT 'fares' AS kind, flight_id AS id, json_object('amount',amount_cents,'count',count(*),'first_confirmed',min(confirmed_at),'last_confirmed',max(confirmed_at)) AS data FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' GROUP BY flight_id,amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
